metadata.question: From August 3 to 9, 2009, did Southern Taiwan experience more rainfall than Northern Taiwan?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation over Taiwan for 2009-08-03 to 2009-08-10 (end exclusive). If empty, fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated precipitation. Define Taiwan from LSIB; fallback to GAUL. Split Taiwan at 23.5°N into North/South.
2. Masking strategy: Precipitation data doesn’t need cloud masking. Restrict to land by intersecting with Taiwan polygon. Count valid pixels to detect C2.
3. Logic to distinguish valid zero from null/error: Check collection size (C1), valid pixel counts (C2), and ensure means are finite numbers (C3). Compare area-mean rainfall; if South > North then A else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const start = '2009-08-03';
  const end = '2009-08-10'; // exclusive
  const latDivide = 23.5;

  // Helper to get Taiwan geometry with fallbacks
  async function getTaiwanGeometry() {
    let fc = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Taiwan'));
    let size = await fc.size().getInfo();
    if (size === 0) {
      fc = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
        .filter(ee.Filter.or(
          ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Taiwan'),
          ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Taiwan, Province of China')
        ));
      size = await fc.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      return null;
    }
    return fc.geometry();
  }

  const taiwanGeom = await getTaiwanGeometry();
  if (!taiwanGeom) {
    console.log('Error: Taiwan geometry not found.');
    console.log('D');
    return;
  }

  // Build north/south geometries by latitude bands intersected with Taiwan
  const southBox = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([119.0, 21.0, 123.5, latDivide], null, false);
  const northBox = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([119.0, latDivide, 123.5, 26.0], null, false);
  const southGeom = taiwanGeom.intersection(southBox, 1);
  const northGeom = taiwanGeom.intersection(northBox, 1);

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
  let datasetUsed = 'CHIRPS';
  let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filterBounds(taiwanGeom)
    .select('precipitation'); // mm/day

  let nImg = await col.size().getInfo();
  if (nImg === 0) {
    // Fallback to ERA5-Land Daily Aggregated (total_precipitation_sum in m/day)
    datasetUsed = 'ERA5-LAND_DAILY_AGGR';
    let era = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(taiwanGeom)
      .select('total_precipitation_sum');
    nImg = await era.size().getInfo();
    if (nImg === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset CHIRPS Images: 0`);
      console.log(`Dataset ERA5-LAND_DAILY_AGGR Images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    // Convert m to mm, rename to 'precipitation'
    col = era.map(function (img) {
      return img.multiply(1000).rename('precipitation')
        .copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    });
  }

  // 3. Processing
  // Sum precipitation over the period (mm over 7 days)
  const sumImg = col.sum().select('precipitation');

  // Pixel counts (valid pixels after masking)
  const scale = 5000;
  const maxPixels = 1e13;

  const southCount = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: southGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  const northCount = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: northGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  if (southCount === 0 || northCount === 0) {
    console.log(`${datasetUsed} Images: ${nImg}`);
    console.log(`South Pixels: ${southCount}, North Pixels: ${northCount}`);
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Calculation of mean and sum over regions
  const southMean = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: southGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  const northMean = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: northGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  const southSum = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: southGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  const northSum = await ee.Number(
    sumImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: northGeom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('precipitation')
  ).getInfo();

  // 5. Validation & Final Answer
  const invalid = (v) => v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v);
  if (invalid(southMean) || invalid(northMean)) {
    console.log(`${datasetUsed} Images: ${nImg}`);
    console.log(`South Pixels: ${southCount}, North Pixels: ${northCount}`);
    console.log(`South Mean(mm): ${southMean}, North Mean(mm): ${northMean}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // Evidence output (<= 20 lines total)
  console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
  console.log(`Date Range: ${start} to 2009-08-09`);
  console.log(`Images: ${nImg}`);
  console.log(`South Pixels: ${southCount}, North Pixels: ${northCount}`);
  console.log(`South Mean(mm, 7d): ${southMean.toFixed(1)}, North Mean(mm, 7d): ${northMean.toFixed(1)}`);
  console.log(`South Sum(mm·px): ${southSum !== null ? southSum.toFixed(0) : 'null'}, North Sum(mm·px): ${northSum !== null ? northSum.toFixed(0) : 'null'}`);

  // Compare area-mean rainfall
  const answer = southMean > northMean ? 'A' : 'B';
  console.log(answer);
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
